title: Can I BEAT Chess Roulette? (feat. Stockfish)
summary: Rematch of Chess Roulette vs Stockfish 3200 after the site dev fixed the engine. Each side has 5 'bullets in the chamber': whenever a piece moves (including captures) it has a 1/6 chance to explode and be removed, until that side has lost 5 pieces this way. Tony pushes pawns one square at a time to burn his bullets on pawns; Stockfish keeps moving big pieces and loses them. Tony wins with a knight mate.
rules: Every move: the moved piece has a 1/6 chance to explode (removed from the board after moving), consuming one bullet.
Once a side's 5 bullets are used, its pieces no longer explode.
Kings: not stated (inferred kings can't explode).
